reviews_captured_by_me.text: David and his crew did a smaller job for us involving replacing a downdraft range with a conventional double roven range. This included installing new above the range vent, moving and replacing old venting, and moving and adding electrical outlets. He was very accomodating to work our project in between larger ones. David is easy to work with, good at communicating, and follows  through with what was promised. His crew did a beautiful job on the sheet work and finishing steps. All are very professional and take pride in a job well done.

David was excellent in planning and executing the bathroom renovation and kept us informed along the way verifying placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures, and tiling to ensure no surprises and kept our house clean. He is a multi-talented professional.

We are very happy with David's renovation of our first floor bathroom. The job involved removal of the old tile, replacement of a section of the sub-floor, installation of new tile, and replacement of our old sink, toilet and their fixtures. All were very well done. Also, David was prompt and always attentive to our wishes. It was a pleasure to work with him. We will hire David to renovate our two other bathrooms next year and we do not hesitate recommending him for his work.
